stem.text: Two compounds X and Y react to produce compound Z. The reaction is reversible.
When X and Y are mixed together in a closed system a dynamic equilibrium is gradually established.
Which graph could represent the change in the rates of the forward and reverse reactions over time?

stem.alt: Key: dotted line = rate of forward reaction; dashed line = rate of reverse reaction

A.alt: Rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls and levels off; reverse rate (dashed) rises and levels off at a lower rate than the forward rate

B.alt: Rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls to zero; reverse rate (dashed) rises to a peak and then falls to zero

C.alt: Rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls and reverse rate (dashed) rises until both meet and level off at the same rate

D.alt: Rate against time: forward rate (dotted) falls to zero; reverse rate (dashed) rises and levels off at a high rate
